investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: a plain curl GET of the venue's own official concerts RSS feed directly returns real concert permalinks (its own pubDate is the WordPress post-publish timestamp, used only for link discovery — never as the event date); a plain curl GET of an individual concert page directly contains a real schema.org MusicEvent JSON-LD block with an explicit startDate. No browser/headless step was needed.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of https://www.jazzsi.com/concerts/feed/ returned 3 real, current concert permalinks; a plain curl GET of one of those pages directly contained a genuine MusicEvent JSON-LD block with title/startDate/location — no structural/browser escalation was needed.

venue_reference: JazzSí Club (Taller de Músics), El Raval, Barcelona

identity.notes: Official identity confirmed directly from the retained evidence at https://www.jazzsi.com/ (the venue's own domain, redirecting from its parent foundation's tallerdemusics.com/jazzsi-club page).

site_classification.platform: WordPress with a custom 'concert' post type; its own RSS feed is used purely for link discovery (see 'source_record_id' below), with the actual event facts read from each concert page's own JSON_LD_EVENT block — a two-family combination (ingestion/rss/ + ingestion/json-ld/), both completely unchanged and reused.

title.notes: Each concert page's own JSON-LD MusicEvent 'name' field.

start_date.notes: Each concert page's own JSON-LD MusicEvent 'startDate', a full ISO 8601 instant with an explicit UTC offset ('2026-09-18T19:45:00+00:00' for the sampled page) — UTC_INSTANT.

time.notes: Embedded in the same 'startDate' value (see start_date).

end.notes: Not present in the sampled page.

venue_location.notes: Each concert page's own JSON-LD 'location' (a MusicVenue node); this source is a single physical venue, so resolution keys on source_id instead (this project's existing pattern for a single-venue JSON-LD source — matching ingestion/moog-barcelona/harlem-jazz-club precedent).

source_record_id.notes: Each concert's own permalink URL slug, discovered via the venue's own RSS feed link discovery — a stable, source-native identity (the same 'permalink as stable ID' judgement already established for ingestion/paral-lel-62/).

event_url.notes: Each concert page's own JSON-LD 'url' field (== its own permalink).

price.notes: No 'offers' object present on the sampled page.

reasons: acquisition_class RSS (for link discovery) + JSON_LD_EVENT (for facts), both resolved supported classes.

A CONFIRMED public data path retained (3 real upcoming concerts observed live at proof time — a genuinely bounded, near-term-only listing, honestly recorded as such, matching this project's existing Sala Apolo precedent).
title and start_date both PROVEN, directly stated by the source's own JSON-LD.
source_record_id PROVEN via the concert's own stable permalink slug.
recommended_family JSON_LD — completely reuses ingestion/json-ld/ and ingestion/rss/, no new generic module needed; only a tiny venue-specific link-discovery module (ingestion/jazzsi/discovery.mjs).

evidence.description: The venue's own real, live RSS feed of concert posts.
evidence.method: curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser)

evidence.description: One real, live concert detail page with a genuine MusicEvent JSON-LD block (MANIFEST, September 2026).
evidence.method: curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser)

evidence.description: This package's own offline test suite (tests/jazzsi.test.mjs) re-parses the retained evidence above with the actual collector code (ingestion/jazzsi/discovery.mjs, reusing ingestion/rss/parse.mjs and ingestion/json-ld/ unchanged) and asserts the exact fields recorded above.
